Never infer omitted source text is absent. A neutral or negative conclusion is an available result: cite the examined non-qualifying spans as counter evidence, and never return unavailable merely because no span satisfies a positive semantic condition. Return unavailable with no evidence only when the visible text cannot support applying the skill at all (for example empty, truncated, or entirely off-window text). If optional validation_feedback is present, this is the only correction attempt: apply each required_action exactly. The rejected row remains in the saved initial response and is intentionally not duplicated here.
